tool.name: Telosmith
tool.description: Governance records for agentic coding: purpose, requirement and decision records, checks, and the sockets every Dev Kit tool shares.

tools.name: records_list
tools.description: List records (latest version of each id by default), filtered by type or id prefix.

type.description: record type, e.g. requirement or decision

tools.name: record_get
tools.description: Get one record by id (its latest version) or by id@version.

tools.name: records_check
tools.description: Run `aec check` over the records (no edge snapshot). Structural only: a clean result does not establish that a conclusion is true.

skills.name: telosmith-records
skills.description: Read and check a Telosmith-based repository's purpose, requirement and decision records (.aec/records.jsonl) before changing code. Use when a repository has an .aec/ folder and the task touches code a record anchors, or when asked what a module is for or whether a change drifts from its purpose.
